actual_path: Byte at::empty -> selected TensorFactories empty -> NPUCachingAllocator.allocate -> getCurrentNPUStreamNoWait -> stream-keyed block pool
scope-local tensor releases before handler; local_raw_delete -> free(Block), cache insertion or recorded-other-stream events, no implicit device completion
raw pointer/std::function captured; OpCommand Run direct or queued COMPILE_AND_EXECUTE -> copied ExecuteParas/customHandler -> ExecFunc -> opApi captured aclstream
kernel entry/DFC WorkspaceInfo and original GMM/activation/combine/flag last readers; keep old source layout and real stream order
graph capture stream/model-specific private pool, replay ExecuteAsync using recorded addresses, releasePool refcount after graph use; tensor destruction != physical release

guards: TASK_QUEUE dynamic atomic override or sync-launch stream may select direct path; initial /proc environment is not current cached OptionsManager state.
Graph capture rejects queue mode2/default/external capture stream; captured native custom handler allowed; replay may use a different current stream.
CheckForceUncached selects physical malloc/free outside capture; not inferred active from absence of environment.
NPU empty has deterministic fill only if all3 runtime flags true; no blanket zero-fill saving.
Dedicated NPUWorkspaceAllocator is a different explicit unsafe_empty_workspace(size,stream) path; macro at::empty does not select it.

ownership_findings: Caching allocator retains stream-keyed blocks; free/requested counters and Tensor scope do not show physical release. Same-stream submission order can allow reuse after previously submitted device work; no global fence was found in the selected allocate/deleter path.

The macro captures a raw workspace address, not its Tensor. Queued callback copying retains std::function, not a missing workspace Tensor lease. This alone does not prove an observed fault; interleaving/allocation/current binary runtime details are not measured. New fusion/aux-stream work must hold an explicit last-reader lease or prove complete ordering.
Recorded foreign streams create events; capture may defer these. recordStream cannot be replaced by merely recording that an API callback returned.

Private pools can share by explicit handle/refcount; replay does not rerun host empty/GetWorkspaceSize per native node. Cross-layer or graph-bucket pools cannot be assumed independent or all already shared.

Selected DFC holds input/scale/C1-C2/A-activation/counters/flags through routing+MMA+activation+combine/peer protocol. QLI output candidate/index persists beyond scratch, and current arch22 empty LD epilogue still touches reset/init/prefetch/sync. No arbitrary all-workspace alias from C++ scope or empty payload.
